narrative: 每一条路径在每一条都必须完全一致。广告拍摄、预演阶段、一个必须与CGI镜头匹配的瓶子、一次必须嵌入实拍底板的特技：机械臂不做任何自主发挥。
人工操作的推轨会产生漂移。360°环绕如果由人步行完成，也会带有呼吸般的细微变化。
高速机械臂（Bolt Cam）是一次抛掷式的运动，而不是可重复的曲线路径（除非这次抛掷本身也是机械化完成的）。如果你想要的是误差和生命力，就不要用这种机械臂。
how: 使用运动控制臂或六轴机器人，预先编程XYZ坐标和摇摆、俯仰、横滚角度。速度可以做到非人般的均匀，或者非人般的快速。
产品展示台、防护垫，或可重复的环绕运动。提示词：Robotic arm move around [Subject], programmed path, inhuman precision, product or stunt geometry.
when: 当各条镜头必须完全匹配时使用：视效镜头、产品广告、特技底板。不要把它用在需要人工漂移感的场景中。
vs: 360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）可以是人工步行，或带有呼吸感的圆形推轨。高速机械臂（Bolt Cam）则是一次瞄准撞击瞬间的抛掷式运动。
机械臂运镜则是可重复的曲线路径，形状可以任意，但没有任何晃动。
examples_film: 广告拍摄和预演阶段是这种语法的本源场景：需要合成的瓶子、汽车和特技几何关系。精确本身就是它的风格。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是斯坦尼康环绕。破绽在于：出现轻微的摇摆，以及人为的加速节奏。
解决办法：写明预先编程的路径、每条完全一致的镜头，没有操作者带来的晃动。

faq.q: 电影中的机械臂运镜（Robo Arm）是什么？
faq.a: 机械臂运镜是摄影机沿一条预先编程的路径运动，每一条都可以完全重复，没有任何人为晃动。产品广告和特技几何关系常常用到它。

faq.q: 机械臂运镜（Robo Arm）与360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）的区别
faq.a: 360°环绕可以是圆形的步行或推轨运动，带有呼吸感。机械臂运镜也可以做环绕运动，但关键在于一条预先编程、每条镜头都能完全匹配的曲线路径。

faq.q: 什么时候该用机械臂运镜（Robo Arm）？
faq.a: 当路径必须完全一致时使用：视效底板、产品广告、特技镜头。当你想要人为的误差感时，不要用它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写机械臂运镜（Robo Arm）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明一条没有晃动的预编程路径。示例：Robotic arm move around [Subject], programmed path, inhuman precision, product or stunt geometry.

narrative: The path must be identical every take. Commercials, previs stages, a bottle that must match a CGI pass, a stunt that must fit a plate: the arm does not interpret.
A human dolly will drift. An orbit-360 can be walked and will breathe.
Bolt cam is a throw, not a repeatable spline (unless the throw is itself robotic). If you want error and life, do not use the arm.
how: Motion-control arm or a six-axis robot, programmed XYZ and pan/tilt/roll. Speed can be inhumanly even or inhumanly fast.
Product tables, crash pads, or a repeatable orbit. Prompt: Robotic arm move around [Subject], programmed path, inhuman precision, product or stunt geometry.
when: Use it when takes must match: VFX, product, a stunt plate. Do not use it for a scene that needs human drift.
vs: 360-Degree Orbit can be a human walk or a circular dolly with breath. Bolt Cam is a crash throw aimed at impact.
Robo-arm is the repeatable spline, any shape, no shake.
examples_film: Commercials and previs stages are the native grammar: bottles, cars, and stunt geometry that must composite. The precision is the style.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a steadicam orbit. The tell: a little sway, a human accel.
The fix: write programmed path, identical takes, no operator shake.

faq.q: What is Robo Arm in film?
faq.a: A robo arm is a robotic camera on a programmed path, repeatable every take, with no human shake. Product and stunt geometry live here.
An orbit-360 is a circular walk or dolly and can breathe. A robo arm can orbit, but the point is a programmed spline that matches take to take.

faq.q: When should I use Robo Arm?
faq.a: Use it when the path must be identical: VFX plates, product, stunts. Do not use it when you want human error.

faq.q: How do I prompt Robo Arm for AI image or video?
